prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Houston after a car wreck. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll give you a short, prioritized list of specific Houston personal-injury firms to call and explain why each is a good pick. To make the recommendations as useful as possible I need one quick detail:

- What ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston are you in (so I can prioritize firms near you)?
- Also: was the wreck minor, serious/catastrophic, or did it involve a death?

If you prefer not to share location, I can still give a general list of well-regarded Houston firms and why to call them.

While you decide, here are immediate practical steps and what to ask any lawyer you call (so you can act now):

Immediate steps after a wreck
- Get medical care right away and keep records. Even mild injuries should be documented.
- Get the police report number and photos of vehicle damage, skid marks, injuries, and scene.
- Preserve contact info for witnesses.
- Don’t give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer without a lawyer.
- Keep a log of symptoms, medical visits, time missed from work, and out-of-pocket expenses.

What to ask when you call a lawyer (so you can compare firms)
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases full time? Do you handle my injury type (catastrophic, whiplash, wrongful-death, etc.)?
- Are you board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) or have trial verdict experience?
- What is your contingency fee and are there any other fees I should expect if we don’t recover?
- Do you advance case costs (medical record retrieval, expert fees) or do I have to pay up front?
- How will you communicate with me and who will be my main contact?
- Do you have experience negotiating with the insurance companies involved (including commercial or trucking insurers) or taking cases to trial?
- Can you provide recent verdicts/settlements or client references (redacted)?

If you want, tell me your ZIP and injury severity now and I’ll return 6–8 specific Houston firms to call (with brief reasons why each is a good match and what to expect from them).
